translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

content: Pédrona' na' Cornéliona'
Na' yell Cesareana' wzoa to beṉ' wlie' Cornelio, na' nak lall' nee zan soldadka', na' beṉ'ka' nak lall' nee wlegake' Beṉ' Italia.

Na' Cornéliona' len beṉ'ka' nakgake' toz ḻoo yoo lille'na' choe'la'ogake' Chioza' na' chall chllebgake'ne'. Na' zoatezi zoe' choe'ḻwille' Chioza' na' cho'e mech xen kwenc̱he chaklene' beṉ' Israelka', beṉ'ka' chyallj chc̱hinin.
To lla, do ka chida shoṉ, ble'do'ile' to anjl c̱he Chioza' wyo'e gana' zoe' na' golle'ne': ―¡Cornelio!
Na' Cornéliona' chwiayeṉee anjla' do chllebze', na' golle'ne': ―¿Beran cheenilo' beṉ'do'? Na' anjla' chi'ene': ―Chioza' chibaile' daa zoatezi zo' choe'ḻwillo'ne' na' daa chakleno' beṉ' yesh'ka'.
Na' ṉaa bseḻ' beṉ' shajgake' yell Jópena' kwenc̱he lljx̱i'gake' beena' le Simón Pedro.
Zoe' lill to beṉ' le Simón, beena' chkoll yid, na' lille'na' zoan gaoz cho'a nisdo'na'. Na' Simón Pédrona' iṉe' li' daa chiyaḻ' gono'.
Na' ka biza' anjla' bshaljlen Cornéliona', na'ch Cornéliona' goxe' c̱hop xmose'na', na' sto soldad, beena' nonḻilallee Chioza' na' zoe' chaklene'ne' chgwee xṉezi bittez.
Na' golle' ḻegake' yog' daa goll anjla', na'ch bseḻee ḻegake' Jópena'.
Na' betiyo do ka gobill ba zoa illin beṉ'ka' bseḻ' Cornéliona' yell Jópena'. Na' ka lo gora', Pédrona' wyepe' koll' yoona' gana' zoe' kwenc̱he we'ḻwille' Chioza'.
Na' wdone', na' goklallee gawe' sheḻ'ka'. Na' shlak chongake' daa gawe', ble'do'ile'
byalj yabana', na' to dii nak ka to lech' xen dii nchej tap yic̱hjten chetjan lo yona'.
Na' ḻoo lechaa lle' biya bayix̱', no ba llia tap ṉi'a na'in, na' no ba chx̱obi ḻeeb lo yona' na' no ba zoa x̱ilin.
Na'ch benile' shii to beṉ', chi'ene': ―Wzolla' Pedro. Bet baka', na' wdao.
Na'ch Pédrona' golle'ne': ―Bi gaw' baka', X̱an'; ni shlin biṉ' gaw' baki bi nak ba xilall'.
Na' sto shii benile' shii beena', chi'ene': ―Daa ba wna Chioza' wak gawo', bich iṉazo' bi nakan xilall'.
Shoṉ shii golle' ka', na'ch biyep lechaa yabana'.
Na' chibani Pédrona' chakile' bera zejin daa ble'do'ile', ka bllin beṉ'ka' bseḻ' Cornéliona' cho'a yoona' gana' zoe', daa ba wṉabgake' gan zoa lill beena' le' Simón, beena' chkoll' yid xa bayix̱'ka'.
Na' ka bllingake', na' wṉegake' zillj wṉabgake' shi nan' zoa to beṉ' le Simón Pedro.
Na' Pédrona' zie' wṉeyi c̱heyi daa ble'do'ile', kat' wne Espíritu Sántona', chi'ene': ―Bwiakachi, na' lle' shoṉ beṉ' chiyiljgake' li'.
Bizolla' na' biyetj, na' wyajlengake'. Bi gakc̱hopilo', ḻa' nadaan bseḻaa ḻegake'.
Na'ch biyetj Pédrona' gana' lle' beṉ'ka' bseḻ' Cornéliona'. Na' chi'e ḻegake': ―Nadaan beena' chiyiljle. ¿Beran chak c̱hele zidwiale nad'?

Na'ch che' beṉ'ka' Pédrona': ―To beṉ' wṉabia' c̱he soldadka' lie' Cornelio bseḻee neto'. Nake' to beṉ' zej shḻi lao Chioza' na' ngooshosh yic̱hje'ne', na' yog' beṉ' Israelka' ṉezgakile' zoe' chone' wen. Na' to anjl c̱he Chioza' golle'ne' iṉie' li' kwenc̱he shajo' lille'na' wzajniilo'ne' na' wzenague' dill'ka' we'leno'ne'.
Na'ch Pédrona' wlo'e ḻegake' ḻoo yoolə gana' zoe', na' bigaaṉgake' shyel. Na' betiyo wyajlen Pédrona' ḻegake' na' len to c̱hop beṉ' Jope, beṉ' nonḻilall' Jesúza'.
Na' llana' sto bllingake' Cesareana'. Na' Cornéliona' ba btope' yog'ḻoḻ dialla c̱he'na' na' beṉ'ka' nllaguile', na' ba lle'gake' lille'na' chbezgake' illin Pédrona'.
Na' ka bllin Pédrona' lill Cornéliona', lii bchejte Cornéliona' bc̱hek' xibe'na' lawe'na' choe'laweene'.
Na' Pédrona' bisolléene', chi'ene': ―Bizolla', bi wc̱hekz' xibo' lawii, ḻa' ḻekzka' beṉ'zə nad'.
Na'ch shlak chshaljgake' wyoogake' ḻoo yoona', na' ble'i Pédrona' beṉ' zan ba lle'.

Na'ch golle' ḻegake': ―Le' ṉezile ka na ley c̱hento'na', neto' beṉ' Israel bi chiyaḻ' gonnto' txen le' bi nakle beṉ' Israel, na' ni bi chiyaḻ' sho'nto' ḻoo yoo lill-le. Per Chioza' ba bzajniile' nad' bi chiyaḻ' gakid' zban nottez beṉ'.
Daan ka bla' beṉ'ki chṉegake' nad', lii za'tia' bi bc̱hia' dill'. Na' ṉaa cheenid' iṉezid' bic̱he bseḻoo beṉ'ki bidx̱i'gake' nad'.
Na'ch Cornéliona' chi'ene': ―Ba gok tap lla, do ka ṉaayeṉ', chida shoṉ, choe'ḻwill' Chioza' ḻoo lillii kat' ble'id' to beṉ' byo zie' lawa' nakwe' to lech' dii chey cheeni'.
Na' wne' nad': “Cornelio, Chioza' ba bzenague' daa choe'ḻwillo'ne', na' ḻekzka' chle'ile' ka chakleno' beṉ' yesh'ka'.
Na' bseḻ' beṉ' shajgake' yell Jópena' lljx̱i'gake' Simón Pédrona' kwenc̱he yide' we'lene' li' dill'. Zoe' lill to beṉ' le Simón, beṉ' chkoll yid, na' lill beeni zoan gaoz cho'a nisdo'na'.”
Daan lii bentia' wṉeyi bidx̱i'gake' li', na' chox̱keno' ba bido'. Na' ṉezkzi Chioza' yog'nto' cheeninto' wzenagnto' yog' cho'a dillaa daa cheenile' iṉo' neto'.
Be' Pédrona' dill' lill Cornéliona'
Na'ch wzolo Pédrona' bi'e dill', chi'e: ―Chakbe'id' ṉaa, dii ḻi Chioza' aga nakzi beṉ' chakile',
san chle'shiile' yog' beṉ' lle' gattez yell kon shi chall chllebgake'ne' na' chongake' daa nak shḻi.
Chioza' bseḻee beṉ' wdix̱je'ile' neto' beṉ' Israel dill' wen dill' kob c̱he'na' nan wak yizoalenchone' mbalaz daa bseḻee Jesucrístona', beena' nak X̱an yog'ḻoḻcho.
Ṉezkzile kwasḻoḻ diika' gok gana' mbani Judeana', daa wzolo gana' mbani Galileana' ka wde wdix̱je'i dii Juanna' beṉ' nan chonan byen yiyaj yilengakile' na' c̱hoagake' nis.
Ṉezile Chioza' bi'e Jesús, beṉ' Nazareta', yeḻ' wak na' Espíritu Sántona', na' wda Jesúza' bene' dii wenka' na' biyone' yog' beṉ'ka' ntakw nc̱hej dii x̱iwaa, daa wzoalen Chioza' ḻe'.
Neto' choe'nto' dill' c̱he yog'te diika' ben Jesúza' Jerusalénna' na' doxen gana' mbani Judeana'. Na' biyoll bene' diika', betgake'ne' bda'gake'ne' ḻee yag cruza'.
Per Chioza' bisbane'ne' ladj beṉ' wetka' biyoṉ llana', na' bidli'lawe' neto'.

Aga yog' beṉ' bli'lao Jesúza' ka bibane' ladj beṉ' wetka', san bli'lawe' toz neto', neto' naknto' beṉ' ba wlej Chioza' kwenc̱he we'nto' xtilleena'. Na' neto' weej wdaolennto'ne' ka wde bibane' ladj beṉ' wetka'.
Na' Jesúza' bseḻee neto' c̱hix̱je'into' beṉ' nan Chioza' nzoe'ne' kwenc̱he gone' yeḻ' josc̱his c̱he yog'ḻoḻ beṉ', ka beṉ' mban na' ka beṉ' ba wit.
Na' ḻekzka' kani'yi yog' dii beṉ'ka' wdix̱jee daa goll Chioza' ḻegake' be'gake' xtill' Jesúza', wnagake' Chioza' yizi'xene' saaxya c̱he nottezə beṉ' gonḻilallee Jesúza'.
Wyoo Espíritu Sántona' ḻoo yic̱hjlall'do' beṉ'ka' bi nak beṉ' Israel
Na' ni chshaljte Pédrona', kat' Espíritu Sántona' wyo'e ḻoo yic̱hjlall'do' yog' beṉ'ka' chzenaggake' xtilleena'.
Na' beṉ' Israelka' nonḻilall' Jesúza', beṉ'ka' bllinlen Pédrona' lill Cornéliona', bibangakile' daa wyoo Espíritu Sántona' ḻoo yic̱hjlall'do' beṉ'ka' bi nak beṉ' Israel.
Na' bengakile' chṉe beṉ'ka' wde wdeli dill' dii bi nombia'gake', choe'la'ogake' Chioza'.
Na' Pédrona' golle' beṉ' Israelka' lle' na': ―Aga no gak wllon wchoa beṉ'ki nisa', ḻa' ba yoo Espíritu Sántona' ḻoo yic̱hjlall'do'eka' ka ba yo'e cho'.
Na' ben Pédrona' mandad wchoagake' nisa' daa chonḻilall'gake' X̱ancho Jesucrístona'. Na' biyolla' wṉabgakile' Pédrona' kwenc̱he bigaaṉlene' ḻegake' c̱hop shoṉ lla.
